title: AI+ Global AI Investment Summit Held in Beijing — UAE Digital-Intelligence Committee Launched
summary: On Apr 26, 2023, the AI+ Global Artificial Intelligence Investment & Financing Summit and founding ceremony of the UAE International Investment Annual Conference Digital-Intelligence Ecosystem Committee convened in Beijing. Guided by the Committee; hosted by Unique Capital +
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / event · May 8, 2023 · Full rewrite — not a stub

On Apr 26, 2023, the AI+ Global Artificial Intelligence Investment & Financing Summit and founding ceremony of the UAE International Investment Annual Conference Digital-Intelligence Ecosystem Committee convened in Beijing. Guided by the Committee; hosted by Unique Capital + Xunyi Ventures; strategic partners included Business Cognition Institute, Asia Digital Economy Academy, Dongyi Wujie Wuji, Zhongshi Tech, Shanghe Capital, Defeng Investment, Jiuyun Changying, Beijing Digital Creative Industry Association, and the National Culture & Finance Cooperation Demonstration Zone Service Center.

Host: Tang Di (Business Cognition Institute). Attendees (sample): Dubai United International Wang Cong; Committee SG Liu Xiaojing; Vice-SG / Xunyi / Business Cognition founder Yin Muyan; Unique Capital founding partner Wu Wei; YouShi Capital Xing Jie; Wanliu Tech founder / ex-Baidu Fengchao Jiao Shidou; digital curator / Open Source Village Yue Luping; AWS startup ecosystem Pan Jierong; Different Capital Dai Chen; Yuanshu Shen Dongliang; Huashan Capital Chen Yu; Lion City Capital Guo Yanni; Wutongshu Tong Weiliang; Linxi Chen Xuetao; Longyi Zhou Hongguang; Xintian Jiang Yujie; GSR Wen Mianmian; Weizhi Ni Tianyang; Shuimu Si Wenmin; CITIC Construction Wang Ye; Unique Capital partners Hu Xiaojing & Wang Chaochao; plus founders from Youlianyun, Chopstick Tech, Yunxiang, BiYou, Moxiang, kua.ai, Quakey, Monkey Infinite, Ruiqi, Attribuly — 100+ investors/entrepreneurs.

Keynotes & messages

Dubai Oasis Authority welcome: China as tech-revolution pioneer; invite firms to Dubai Silicon Valley. UAE Investment Annual Conference China DG Gao Junxuan: Committee founding near 40 years of China–UAE ties; prefer Chinese digital solutions for Arab digital transformation. Wu Wei: Unique Capital all-in AIGC; among earliest China AIGC maps/research houses — AIGC is conviction not a fad; AI 2.0 already daily work/life — “hit what is in front of you.” Yin Muyan: hard-tech investing = investing in scientists (≥10yr depth) + authoritative collective decisions; MidEast/Europe capital networks ready. Liu Xiaojing: true ecosystems are co-built not stacked; 12th UAE Investment Annual — participating firms’ valuation already >$230B across Americas/MENA/Oceania; MidEast intent toward China >$380B; Committee as hub for digital “little giants” → unicorns.

Jiao Shidou — “How enterprises fully embrace the AGI era”: third-time founder; inflection on human–machine and machine–machine relations; don’t flip strategy lightly — focus on underlying logic. Yue Luping — art/world/self in the AI age (assignment from economist Zhu Jiaming): show AIGC works; manifesto and creation together; open-source futurism 2.0.

Roundtable & afternoon demoday

Moderator Wang Chaochao with Dai Chen / Shen Dongliang / Chen Yu / Yin Muyan / Guo Yanni on “AI+ investment opportunities & challenges.” Dai: like early mobile internet — product fit + efficiency take time; invest early for asymmetric upside or pay up for growth; bet on proven people. Shen: excitement → then fear of exponential pace; prefer ToB with data + industry know-how; don’t chase fads. Chen: first paid internet moment wasn’t day one — AI+ opens a ~30yr super-cycle; don’t rush.

Afternoon closed-door pitches (~80+ domestic/foreign investors): Youlianyun Shi Yiqiang, Chopstick Chen Wanfeng, Yunxiang Sha Tao, BiYou Zhou Ze’an, Moxiang Gao Peng, kua.ai Gong Yi, Quakey Zhang Wenzhuo, Monkey Infinite Yin Bohao, Ruiqi Yu Wei, Attribuly Li Ju.

Also: Committee founding unveiling; “Global AI Industry Fund” intent ceremony (Yue/Dai/Xing/Yin/Liu/Chen/Wang/Hu). Morning closed with group photo.

21 CN images; attach on ingest. Edit: Suxing; review Yin Muyan.

— END —
